description: Source code for a Zephyr driver implementing a quadrature decoder (QDEC) for NXP S32 microcontrollers, including initialization, overflow handling, and sensor data fetching.

methods.name: qdec_emios_overflow_count_cw_callback
methods.description: Callback to increment clockwise overflow count.

methods.name: qdec_emios_overflow_count_ccw_callback
methods.description: Callback to increment counterclockwise overflow count.

methods.name: qdec_s32_fetch
methods.description: Fetches current encoder counts and computes absolute position.

methods.name: qdec_s32_ch_get
methods.description: Converts encoder count to rotation in radians.

methods.name: qdec_s32_initialize
methods.description: Initializes the quadrature decoder hardware and driver.
